definitions.contact_semantics: 5ms PhysX normal force vector norm, excludes friction; 10N and>=15ms descriptive only
definitions.control_sampling: post physics pre reset, reference phase +20ms
definitions.height_error: base-link origin world Z minus reference base-link Z; not 3D norm
definitions.joint_position_error: unwrapped direct difference; wheel angle not a leg-posture metric
definitions.scope_limit: single seed and few cycles; deterministic nominal repeats not independent trials
definitions.vertical_velocity: base COM linear velocity, rotated body to world; not whole-robot COM
definitions.wheel_phase_statistics: both wheels pooled, physics substeps grouped by control reference frame; actual samples +5..20ms

primary_scope: complete frame0..169 cycles; all-observed scope retained separately
